valuation_template_rationale: Albemarle's earnings are dominated by lithium price, production and unit-cost sensitivity, so normalized cyclical earnings are more appropriate than capitalizing the latest quarter.
bear_assumptions: USD 0.95 billion adjusted EBITDA near USD 10/kg LCE, less USD 0.67 billion normalized D&A and USD 0.13 billion interest, 25% tax, 136 million diluted shares and 12x trough normalized earnings; contract lags, fixed costs and supply response persist.
base_assumptions: USD 2.50 billion adjusted EBITDA near USD 20/kg LCE, less USD 0.67 billion normalized D&A and USD 0.13 billion interest, 25% tax, 136 million diluted shares and 14x normalized earnings; volume, contracts and costs broadly follow current guidance.
bull_assumptions: USD 4.30 billion adjusted EBITDA near USD 30/kg LCE, less USD 0.67 billion normalized D&A and USD 0.13 billion interest, 25% tax, 136 million diluted shares and a cycle-discounted 12x normalized earnings; pricing persists and execution remains controlled.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if post-results trading and fresh primary evidence preserve base upside while confidence-adjusted expected return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, confidence and relationship gates all pass; downgrade if lithium pricing, contract realization, volume, recurring cash conversion, Talison output, capex, leverage or dilution deteriorates.
